blocks.text: The Zscaler and Cyware Deployment Guide provides instructions on integrating Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Deception with the Cyware Threat Intelligence Exchange (CTIX) and Cyware Orchestrate platform.
ZIA works with the CTIX application as an enrichment tool to enrich threat data such as hashes, domains, or URLs in the CTIX application.
Zscaler and Cyware Orchestrator work together with the following Playbook automations:

blocks.item: Deception: The Deception app helps detect and prevent attacks by using decoys to mislead attackers, providing real-time visibility into threats.

ZIA: The ZIA app provides comprehensive network security by enhancing visibility into internet usage, protecting against threats like malicious URLs and botnets, and securing all internet traffic, users, and devices.
